agent.message: This crumpled paper flies like a projectile where air drag is proportional to its velocity: downward acceleration is Earth gravity minus k times velocity. The fitted drag rate k ≈ 2.4 per second means air resistance removes about 2.4x its speed per second, giving a velocity decay time of ~0.4 s, which dominates the short 0.9 s flight. That linear-drag law forecasts the held-out trajectory to within 2.9% and beats the no-drag and quadratic-drag alternatives by a wide margin.
